newsitem.title: USA: Harsco Corp unit gets Canadian rail contract.
newsitem.headline: Harsco Corp unit gets Canadian rail contract.

text.p: Harsco Corp said Monday its Fairmont Tamper Division has won a seven-year contract to provide railroad tie replacement services for the Canadian National Railway.
Terms of the contract were not disclosed.
The company said the contract calls for Fairmont Tamper to supply and manage one work crew, replacing up to 240,000 ties per year.

The company said it is the first contract outside the United States connected to Fairmont's "Tie Masters" program. The program involves Fairmont providing all equipment, supplies and machine maintenance, while it also manages the railroad's own work crews.
